chapters.label: Ready to shoot
chapters.text: Porto, 2021, the Champions League final. Kevin De Bruyne races down the left, ready to shoot. But N'Golo Kanté is sprinting back!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Kanté never stops running. He slides in from behind and hooks the ball away. What a tackle!

chapters.label: No shot
chapters.text: From behind the goal: no shot for De Bruyne. Kanté was named player of the match, and Chelsea won the cup.

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That is the ball-winning sprint! When you lose the ball, press straight away: sprint, get close, win it back. The best time is right away.
